page.layout: One printed page: a full-page engraving (woodcut plate) of a crucifixion-type scene with a figure bound to an upright post and a crossbar, landscape behind, with the printed plate number "P. 144" (rotated) at the lower left of the image. A library stamp (blue oval, "Manuele ..." / "Biblioteca" lettering) overlaps the lower right and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page carries only an engraving, no running text. The plate's small inverted numeral at lower left reads "P. 144" (printed rotated, possibly "P. 144" or "P. 149"; uncertain). The blue stamp at lower right is a library stamp and is omitted. An ornamental printer's band appears at the very bottom edge, partly cut off, with no legible text. No text blocks are present to transcribe.
